name: firecrawl
description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.
one_liner: A service that turns any website into clean, structured data an AI program can read — like giving your AI agent eyes that can browse the entire internet for you.
buyer: A founder building an AI product (research assistant, price tracker, lead-gen tool) who needs reliable web data without building and maintaining their own scraper.
business_use_cases: A competitive-intelligence startup uses it to continuously scrape competitor pricing pages and feed changes into a client dashboard.
An AI recruiting tool uses it to pull and structure job postings and company pages at scale for candidate matching.
A no-code automation agency bills clients to build 'website monitor + alert' workflows on top of the API.

money_ideas.idea: Build a vertical product (e.g. 'competitor price monitoring for e-commerce') on top of the API and resell it as a subscription.
Charge clients for custom scraping/data pipelines billed by pages or credits consumed.

steal_this: Build a 'daily competitor price change' email digest for a niche (e.g. local furniture stores) using the scrape API, and sell it as a $29/mo tool to shop owners.
